description: Fenix Agent Plugin — skill definitions for seeding into Fenix DB

skills.name: using-fenix
skills.description: Bootstrap meta-skill for AI agents using the Fenix platform. Teaches when and how to use Fenix MCP tools with structured workflows. Injected at session start.

skills.name: fenix-memory-protocol
skills.description: Complete memory protocol for AI agents using Fenix. Defines when and how to search, save, and link memories for cross-session continuity.

skills.name: fenix-product-planning
skills.description: Workflow for translating business requirements into epics, features, and stories in Fenix.

skills.name: fenix-technical-planning
skills.description: Workflow for breaking a story into tasks through a structured discussion phase with decision capture.

skills.name: fenix-technical-development
skills.description: Workflow for implementing tasks with TDD discipline, read-first rule, and wave execution.

skills.name: fenix-technical-review
skills.description: Workflow for reviewing implemented code with decision context from planning phase.

skills.name: fenix-technical-delivery
skills.description: Workflow for finalizing a story after all tasks pass review. Closes story, updates docs, cleans up.
